fields.name: table
fields.label: Comparison table
fields.description: One bulleted list. The FIRST bullet is the header row. Each bullet is one row: type the factor in bold, then press Enter and Tab to make two sub-bullets under it: the first sub-bullet is the Loan Against Securities text, the second is the Selling investments text. Rows 3 to 9 get a green tick / red cross automatically, so keep the row order of the design.
